A fingerless glove (= a piece of clothing for the hand and wrist) does not cover the fingers:

fingerless gloves It was so cold in my bedroom I did my homework in fingerless gloves.

He always wore fingerless leather driving gloves.

I am knitting some fingerless mittens.

Creative-Family/iStock/Getty Images Plus/GettyImages

without any fingers:

The statue still had feet and hands, but they were fingerless.

Mehr Beispiele Weniger Beispiele

  * She wore black lace fingerless gloves.
  * The man was wearing gloves, but they were fingerless and his fingers were blue.
  * The figures were drawn childishly, with fingerless blobs instead of hands.
